no_adcom_quote.quote: This application was not referred to an Advisory Committee meeting as there were no major concerns regarding the safety or efficacy findings from the trials.

summary: No advisory committee was convened for OXBRYTA (voxelotor, NDA213137). The Multidiscipline review states the application was not referred to an Advisory Committee meeting because there were no major concerns regarding the safety or efficacy findings from the trials, and separately that it was not presented at an Advisory Committee or any other external consultants because it did not raise efficacy or safety issues for the recommended indication. Because no committee met, there are no AdComm-driven linkages to the approval.
